semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact card identity, face, starting loyalty, and the registered +1 cost and private look effect.
Registered -10 cost and instant-timing emblem effect.
An empty library does not draw or open a choice after the paid +1.
A one-card library still requires the mandatory private selection.
Private selection from two cards, no reveal or search, and physical zone-generation changes.
The paid ability survives synthetic source departure and replays its accepted commands.
Four-player source-owner departure preserves P10's private mandatory choice and explicit-ID wire replay.
The actual -1 accepts zero, one, or four any-permanent targets.
Five and duplicate targets are rejected before the loyalty cost is paid.
Stale target generations do not untap a new object incarnation.
Stun counters and an untap prohibition do not publish false untap events.
A simultaneous synthetic cohort resolves conditional untap prohibitions in both orders.
Paid -10 activation, zero-loyalty source state action, and controller-scoped marker creation.
The emblem permits one actual off-turn Jace activation above an unresolved Bolt.
Off-turn loyalty timing requires the controller's emblem.
A cleanup-priority timing offer is refreshed from current engine state.
The emblem does not allow activation outside modeled instant-timing steps.
The emblem does not override an ability's explicit sorcery-speed restriction.
Timing permission follows the current controller and current planeswalker type.
The controller's emblem survives departure of the Teferi owner's game objects.
The emblem leaves and Jace's control reverts to its surviving owner when the emblem controller concedes.
Multiple emblems do not bypass the per-turn count, which resets on a later turn.
Actual Oath, Chain Veil, Carth, and Teferi emblem interactions permit three off-turn uses at +2 loyalty each and reject the fourth.
Engine setup declares the exact Teferi card ID with blue identity and a command-zone object, then tests a separate ordinary mainboard object.
